text:
Maya: Quick ping — planning Wed RFC review (US-friendly window). Need to slot 4 authors and assign reviewers. Can people post availability + reviewer preference? @channel

Ajay: I'm +1 for 10am PT. Can review infra rfc.

Priya: I can do 1pm PT / 4pm ET. Prefer to review runtime stuff. Pre-reads: not finished on infra; will have by EOD Tue.

Devon: 10am PT works for me too. Suggest ordering: infra -> runtime -> optimize -> docs. Infra first because there are cross-cutting deps.

Maya: +1 on that order. Also can we do a quick canary of the infra patch first (5–10m)? Jules, can you lead infra review?

Jules: I can take infra review and do a quick pre-approval if authors fix the TODOs. I'll need the preread checklist filled.

scheduler-bot: Poll created — react with :one: :two: :three: to pick time slot: 1) 10am PT 2) 1pm PT 3) 3pm PT. Meeting link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/9d2a

Priya: Voted :one:. Also leaving a short note for authors: please attach perf numbers if available.

Ajay: :one: from me as well. I'll sign up to take notes + rollout bullets.

Devon: I reacted :two: in case infra needs to loop an extra dev, but :one: is fine.

Maya: OK looks like 10am PT wins. Authors — please drop the preread link + short TL;DR here before EOD Tue. Template below (copy into PR/notes):

```
- PR/branch link
- TL;DR (1-2 lines)
- Key changes + API diffs
- Tests / perf / failure modes
- Rollout plan + fallback
- Open questions for reviewers
```

Priya: I'll nudge authors with that template in a DM and post a reminder Tue morning.

Ajay: I'll prepare a one-slide rollout sketch for infra and an issues checklist.

Maya: Any reviewer conflicts or embargo items? @Jules @Devon

Jules: none from infra side. if authors push new commits after Tue morning I'll re-request review.

Devon: none. I'll handle runtime after infra.

Maya: Great — I'll send calendar invite and post the final agenda Tue AM. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks — will follow up on missing prereads.

scheduler-bot: Invite sent to attendees. RSVP summary: Maya (yes), Ajay (yes), Priya (yes), Devon (yes), Jules (yes), authors (pending).
